candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory timing out (DependencyUnavailable: redis operation failed), which makes POST /v1/reservations return 503 and propagates as ReadTimeout/502 up through order to gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs; gateway dependency metric series empty, so redis fault is inferred from traces only.

report.explanation: Traces show a consistent chain: redis.reserve_inventory timeout in inventory, 503 on /v1/reservations, ReadTimeout on order, and 502 at gateway /v1/checkout across four correlated requests. Gateway metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2387ms) and 502s. Bounded candidate is redis-timeout; redis-side telemetry is still needed to confirm the dependency fault.
missing_evidence: Redis/inventory service metrics and logs confirming redis latency or unavailability during the incident window
Gateway dependency operation metrics (simulator_dependency_operations_total) which returned empty series
